title: Don't Politicise Ayodhya Ram Temple Donation Theft, Cautions Supreme Court
description: The Supreme Court on Monday observed that the Ayodhya Ram Mandir donation theft issue should not be politicized. Hearing petitions seeking CBI investigation and audit of the temple Trust finances, Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said, “We are only putting a word of caution. Don't play any politics.
